import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long binPow(long a, int b, int p) {
        if (b == 0)
            return 1;
        long x = binPow(a, b / 2, p);
        x = (x * x) % p;
        if ((b & 1) == 1) {
            x = (x * a) % p;
        }
        return x;
    }

    static int n, k, p;
    static final int MAXN = 250250;
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] rfact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] pw = new long[MAXN];
    static int cnt = 0;
    static long[][] g = new long[MAXN][17];
    static List<Integer> bit = new ArrayList<>();

    static void solve(int n, List<Integer> bit, int k, int l) {
        if (k == bit.size()) {
            ++cnt;
            for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
                g[n][i] += rfact[l] * g[n ^ l][i - 1];
                if (cnt >= 8) {
                    g[n][i] %= p;
                }
            }
            if (cnt >= 8)
                cnt = 0;
            return;
        }
        solve(n, bit, k + 1, l);
        solve(n, bit, k + 1, l ^ (1 << bit.get(k)));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(binPow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        fact[0] = 1;
        rfact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p;
            rfact[i] = binPow(fact[i], p - 2, p);
        }

        g[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if ((i & n) != i)
                continue;
            bit.clear();
            for (int j = 0; j < 18; ++j) {
                if (((1 << j) & i) != 0)
                    bit.add(j);
            }
            solve(i, new ArrayList<>(bit), 1, 1 << bit.get(0));
            for (int j = 0; j < 17; ++j)
                g[i][j] %= p;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(16, k); ++i) {
            g[n][i] %= p;
            long cur = (fact[n] * g[n][i]) % p;
            cur = (cur * fact[k]) % p;
            cur = (cur * rfact[k - i]) % p;
            ans = (ans + cur) % p;
        }
        ans = (binPow(k, n, p) - ans) % p;
        if (ans < 0)
            ans += p;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
